The transaction detail lists, account by account, each transaction at or above the amount set (A$50,000 by default), with everything smaller counted on one line so the totals still add up; AI explains in plain English what moved each balance. Both go to Reports as web pages, are filed in Knowledge as PDFs under Banking/Reports, and are emailed as attachments to the people picked. Read-only in Xero.

# ── Draw the bank balance report - one line per account - put it in Reports, file the PDF and email it ──
import base64
import io
import re
from datetime import date
from typing import Any

from fpdf import FPDF
from PIL import Image

MAIL = "m365-mail-send"
FOLDER = "Banking/Reports"
MONTHS = ["Jan", "Feb", "Mar", "Apr", "May", "Jun", "Jul", "Aug", "Sep", "Oct", "Nov", "Dec"]
# The masthead logo. Taller than this and it crowds the rule beneath; wider and it reaches the title block.
LOGO_H = 11.0
LOGO_W = 60.0
# The whole PDF is base64'd into the mail connector's request, and a logo straight out of a design tool can
# be megabytes. It is drawn 11mm tall, so a few hundred pixels is every pixel it can show.
LOGO_PX = (960, 240)
LOGO_BYTES = 120_000
# The chart's plot area, in mm and in CSS px (about the same height). Kept short so the report stays on one page.
PLOT_H = 24.0
PLOT_PX = 90

NAVY = (22, 37, 64)
GOLD = (176, 141, 87)
GREEN = (29, 115, 80)
RED = (176, 44, 44)
INK = (33, 37, 41)
GREY = (110, 114, 120)
LINE = (222, 220, 214)
GRID = (234, 232, 226)
PAPER = (244, 242, 237)
WHITE = (255, 255, 255)
# The chart's own pair: a rise is teal and a fall is red, so neither depends on reading a minus sign.
TEAL = (23, 97, 130)
BAR_RED = (179, 38, 46)

FOOTNOTE = "Amounts are rounded to whole dollars, so rounded totals can differ from the sum of rounded lines by A$1."


def safe(s):
    """Core PDF fonts are Latin-1 only."""
    s = str(s or "")
    for a, b in (("–", "-"), ("—", "-"), ("‘", "'"), ("’", "'"), ("“", '"'), ("”", '"'), ("•", "-"),
                 ("…", "..."), ("→", "->"), ("▲", "+"), ("▼", "-"), ("≈", "~"), (" ", " ")):
        s = s.replace(a, b)
    return s.encode("latin-1", "ignore").decode("latin-1")


def esc(s):
    return (str(s or "").replace("&", "&").replace("<", "<").replace(">", ">")
            .replace('"', """))


def d_fmt(iso):
    """dd-Mmm-yy, for the file name and the email subject."""
    if not iso:
        return ""
    y, m, d = iso[:10].split("-")
    return d + "-" + MONTHS[int(m) - 1] + "-" + y[2:]


def rnd(n):
    """Whole dollars, half up. Counted in cents first so a sum that lands a hair under .50 still rounds up."""
    cents = int(abs(float(n or 0)) * 100 + 0.5)
    return (cents + 50) // 100


def money(n):
    """A$1,234 - the size of a figure, with no sign."""
    return "A$" + format(rnd(n), ",")


def smoney(n):
    """A balance with its sign, no plus: -A$1,234. One that rounds to nothing is A$0, never -A$0."""
    r = rnd(n)
    return ("-" if float(n or 0) < 0 and r else "") + "A$" + format(r, ",")


def schange(n):
    """A change with its sign: +A$1,234 or -A$1,234."""
    v = float(n or 0)
    r = rnd(v)
    if not r:
        return "A$0"
    return ("+" if v > 0 else "-") + "A$" + format(r, ",")


def pct(diff, prev, dash="-"):
    """(today - previous close) / ABS(previous close), to 1 decimal place, half up. The sign is the direction of
    the change, so a credit card getting further overdrawn is negative. A previous close of exactly 0 has
    nothing to divide by, and says so with a dash rather than a made-up figure."""
    p = float(prev or 0)
    if p == 0:
        return dash
    v = float(diff or 0) / abs(p) * 100
    tenths = int(abs(v) * 10 + 0.5 + 1e-9)
    if not tenths:
        return "0.0%"
    return ("+" if v > 0 else "-") + format(tenths / 10, ",.1f") + "%"


def tone_rgb(direction):
    return GREEN if direction == "up" else (RED if direction == "down" else GREY)


def tone_css(direction):
    return "#1d7350" if direction == "up" else ("#b02c2c" if direction == "down" else "#6e7278")


def way(n):
    v = float(n or 0)
    return "up" if v > 0 else ("down" if v < 0 else "flat")


def moved(account):
    return abs(float(account.get("difference") or 0)) >= 0.005


def size_of_change(account):
    return abs(float(account.get("difference") or 0))


change = params.get("change") or {}
problem = str(params.get("problem") or "")
# The Xero organisation the figures were read from, straight from the connector. It is also the name at the top.
org_name = str(params.get("org_name") or "").strip()

head = change.get("summary") or {}
accounts = change.get("accounts") or []

# -- Who gets it ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Two ways of saying who, and the report goes to both at once: one person picked from the workspace, and any
# addresses typed in for people outside it. Picking beats typing - nobody mistypes an address that then bounces
# where no one sees it.
to = []
lost = []
people = {}
user_id = str(params.get("email_user") or "").strip()
if user_id:
    try:
        for person in api.users.list() or []:
            people[str(person.get("id") or "")] = person
    except Exception as exc:
        lost.append("couldn't read the workspace users (" +
                    str(exc).replace("tool_error: ", "")[:120] + ")")
wanted = []
if user_id:
    wanted.append(user_id)
for who in wanted:
    found = people.get(who) or {}
    if found.get("email"):
        picked = str(found.get("email")).strip()
        if picked.lower() not in [x.lower() for x in to]:
            to.append(picked)
    elif who:
        lost.append("someone picked has no email address on their profile")
for typed in str(params.get("email_to") or "").replace(";", ",").split(","):
    picked = typed.strip()
    if picked and picked.lower() not in [x.lower() for x in to]:
        to.append(picked)
# Said once, however many people it happened to: the point is that the list is short, not who is missing.
lost = sorted(set(lost))
lost_note = (" Some recipients were left off: " + "; ".join(lost) + ".") if lost else ""

# The business's logo, where one has been put in Knowledge. A logo that will not load is said so in the
# summary and the name is set instead - a missing picture is no reason to lose the report.
logo_file = str(params.get("logo_file") or "").strip()
logo_path = ""
logo_uri = ""
logo_size = (0, 0)
logo_note = ""
if logo_file:
    try:
        with open(str(api.files.get(file=logo_file)), "rb") as fh:
            img = Image.open(io.BytesIO(fh.read()))
            img.load()
        img.thumbnail(LOGO_PX)
        buf = io.BytesIO()
        img.save(buf, format="PNG", optimize=True)
        kind, ext = "image/png", ".png"
        if buf.tell() > LOGO_BYTES and img.mode in ("RGB", "L"):
            buf = io.BytesIO()
            img.save(buf, format="JPEG", quality=85, optimize=True)
            kind, ext = "image/jpeg", ".jpg"
        logo_raw = buf.getvalue()
        logo_size = img.size
        logo_path = api.files.scratch_path("logo" + ext)
        with open(logo_path, "wb") as fh:
            fh.write(logo_raw)
        logo_uri = "data:" + kind + ";base64," + base64.b64encode(logo_raw).decode("ascii")
    except Exception as exc:
        logo_path = ""
        logo_uri = ""
        logo_note = " The logo was left off: " + logo_file + " wouldn't load (" + \
            str(exc).replace("tool_error: ", "")[:120] + ")."

report_file = ""
report_link = ""
emailed_to = ""
sent = ""
filed = ""

if problem or not accounts:
    summary = problem or "Nothing to report."
else:
    today = date.today().isoformat()
    title_name = org_name or "Bank Balances"

    # The figures are worked out here from the raw balances, never read off the connector's own text, which
    # carries cents. Accounts that changed come first, biggest first - the order the chart uses too.
    movers = sorted([a for a in accounts if moved(a)],
                    key=lambda a: (-size_of_change(a), str(a.get("name") or "").lower()))
    quiet = sorted([a for a in accounts if not moved(a)], key=lambda a: str(a.get("name") or "").lower())
    ordered = movers + quiet
    opening = sum(float(a.get("previousBalance") or 0) for a in accounts)
    held = sum(float(a.get("balance") or 0) for a in accounts)
    total_diff = held - opening
    total_dir = way(total_diff)
    flow_in = sum(float(a.get("moneyIn") or 0) for a in accounts)
    flow_out = sum(abs(float(a.get("moneyOut") or 0)) for a in accounts)
    n_accounts = int(head.get("accountCount") or len(accounts))
    acc_word = " account" if n_accounts == 1 else " accounts"
    subline = str(head.get("subtitle") or "").strip()
    if org_name:
        subline = (subline + " · " if subline else "") + org_name
    elif subline:
        subline += " · Xero organisation not identified"
    updated = str(head.get("updatedText") or "From Xero bank transactions")

    # -- Drawing helpers ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------
    pdf = FPDF(format="A4", unit="mm")
    pdf.set_auto_page_break(False)
    pdf.set_margins(0, 0, 0)
    pdf.c_margin = 0
    pdf.alias_nb_pages()
    L = 14.0
    CW = 182.0
    TOP = 16.0
    BOTTOM = 277.0

    def font(size, style: Any = "", color=INK):
        pdf.set_font("Helvetica", style, size)
        pdf.set_text_color(*color)

    def label(x, y, text, color=GREY, size=6.5):
        font(size, "B", color=color)
        pdf.set_char_spacing(0.6)
        pdf.text(x, y, safe(str(text).upper()))
        pdf.set_char_spacing(0)

    def hlabel(x, y, w, text, align="L", size=6.0):
        font(size, "B", color=GREY)
        pdf.set_char_spacing(0.5)
        pdf.set_xy(x, y)
        pdf.cell(w, 3.4, safe(str(text).upper()), align=align)
        pdf.set_char_spacing(0)

    def rule(y, color=LINE, width=0.2, x=L, w=CW):
        pdf.set_draw_color(*color)
        pdf.set_line_width(width)
        pdf.line(x, y, x + w, y)

    def text_w(text, size, style: Any = ""):
        pdf.set_font("Helvetica", style, size)
        return pdf.get_string_width(safe(text))

    def fit(text, w, size, style: Any = ""):
        pdf.set_font("Helvetica", style, size)
        t = safe(text)
        if pdf.get_string_width(t) <= w:
            return t
        while t and pdf.get_string_width(t + "...") > w:
            t = t[:-1]
        return t.rstrip() + "..."

    def shrink(text, w, size, style: Any = "", floor=4.4):
        """The largest size, from the one asked for down, at which the text fits the width."""
        while size > floor and text_w(text, size, style) > w:
            size -= 0.3
        return size

    def wrap2(text, w, size, style: Any = ""):
        """A name over at most two lines, the second one cut with dots if it still does not fit."""
        pdf.set_font("Helvetica", style, size)
        words = safe(text).split()
        first = ""
        used = 0
        while used < len(words) and pdf.get_string_width((first + " " + words[used]).strip()) <= w:
            first = (first + " " + words[used]).strip()
            used += 1
        if not first:
            return [fit(text, w, size, style)]
        rest = " ".join(words[used:])
        return [first] + ([fit(rest, w, size, style)] if rest else [])

    def footer():
        rule(285, color=LINE)
        font(6.5, "", color=GREY)
        pdf.set_xy(L, 286.5)
        pdf.cell(CW * 0.7, 3.5, safe(updated))
        pdf.set_xy(L, 286.5)
        pdf.cell(CW, 3.5, safe("PAGE " + str(pdf.page_no()) + " OF {nb}"), align="R")

    def masthead(first):
        pdf.add_page()
        footer()
        if not first:
            label(L, TOP, title_name + " - bank balances", color=GREY)
            rule(TOP + 2.5, color=LINE)
            return TOP + 9.0
        y = TOP
        if logo_path and logo_size[0]:
            w = min(LOGO_W, LOGO_H * logo_size[0] / logo_size[1])
            pdf.image(logo_path, x=L, y=y, w=w, h=w * logo_size[1] / logo_size[0])
        else:
            font(15, "B", color=NAVY)
            pdf.text(L, y + 8, fit(title_name, CW * 0.4, 15, "B"))
        font(13, "B", color=NAVY)
        pdf.set_xy(L, y)
        pdf.cell(CW, 7, safe("BANK BALANCES"), align="R")
        size = shrink(subline, CW * 0.66, 7.5)
        font(size, "", color=GREY)
        pdf.set_xy(L, y + 7)
        pdf.cell(CW, 4, safe(subline), align="R")
        rule(y + 12.5, color=NAVY, width=0.6)
        return y + 18.5

    # A cursor walked down the page, taking a new one whenever the next row will not fit.
    page = [1]
    y_now = [0.0]

    def need(h):
        if y_now[0] + h <= BOTTOM:
            return False
        page[0] += 1
        y_now[0] = masthead(False)
        return True

    y_now[0] = masthead(True)

    # -- Three figures across the top ---------------------------------------------------------------------
    KH = 21.0
    k1, k2 = 74.0, 52.0
    k3 = CW - k1 - k2
    ky = y_now[0]
    pdf.set_fill_color(*PAPER)
    pdf.set_draw_color(*LINE)
    pdf.set_line_width(0.2)
    pdf.rect(L, ky, CW, KH, style="DF")
    pdf.line(L + k1, ky + 3, L + k1, ky + KH - 3)
    pdf.line(L + k1 + k2, ky + 3, L + k1 + k2, ky + KH - 3)

    label(L + 5, ky + 6, "Total change across " + str(n_accounts) + acc_word, size=6.0)
    big = schange(total_diff)
    font(17, "B", color=tone_rgb(total_dir))
    pdf.text(L + 5, ky + 14.2, safe(big))
    big_w = text_w(big, 17, "B")
    font(10, "B", color=tone_rgb(total_dir))
    pdf.text(L + 5 + big_w + 3, ky + 14.2, safe(pct(total_diff, opening)))
    font(7, "", color=GREY)
    pdf.text(L + 5, ky + 18.4, safe("vs previous close " + smoney(opening)))

    label(L + k1 + 5, ky + 6, "Held across all accounts", size=6.0)
    font(17, "B", color=NAVY)
    pdf.text(L + k1 + 5, ky + 14.2, safe(smoney(held)))
    font(7, "", color=GREY)
    pdf.text(L + k1 + 5, ky + 18.4, safe("as at " + d_fmt(today)))

    label(L + k1 + k2 + 5, ky + 6, "Money in / out", size=6.0)
    in_t = money(flow_in) + " in"
    out_t = money(flow_out) + " out"
    fs = shrink(in_t + "  /  " + out_t, k3 - 9, 10.5, "B")
    font(fs, "B", color=GREEN)
    pdf.text(L + k1 + k2 + 5, ky + 14.2, safe(in_t))
    x2 = L + k1 + k2 + 5 + text_w(in_t, fs, "B")
    font(fs, "", color=GREY)
    pdf.text(x2 + 1.5, ky + 14.2, "/")
    font(fs, "B", color=RED)
    pdf.text(x2 + 5, ky + 14.2, safe(out_t))
    font(7, "", color=GREY)
    pdf.text(L + k1 + k2 + 5, ky + 18.4,
             safe("across " + str(len(movers)) + (" account" if len(movers) == 1 else " accounts") + " that moved"))
    y_now[0] = ky + KH + 5.5

    # -- Change by account: one column each, the biggest first ---------------------------------------------
    cy = y_now[0]
    label(L, cy + 3, "Change by account · biggest first", size=6.5)
    tail = "  ·  bar height = size of change"
    if quiet:
        tail += "  ·  " + str(len(quiet)) + (" account" if len(quiet) == 1 else " accounts") + \
            " with no change not shown"
    font(6.2, "", color=GREY)
    lx = L + CW - (text_w(tail, 6.2) + text_w("Increase", 6.2) + text_w("Decrease", 6.2) + 12.0)
    pdf.set_fill_color(*TEAL)
    pdf.rect(lx, cy + 1.2, 2.2, 2.2, style="F")
    font(6.2, "", color=GREY)
    pdf.text(lx + 3.2, cy + 3.1, "Increase")
    lx += 3.2 + text_w("Increase", 6.2) + 3.0
    pdf.set_fill_color(*BAR_RED)
    pdf.rect(lx, cy + 1.2, 2.2, 2.2, style="F")
    font(6.2, "", color=GREY)
    pdf.text(lx + 3.2, cy + 3.1, "Decrease")
    pdf.text(lx + 3.2 + text_w("Decrease", 6.2), cy + 3.1, safe(tail))

    base = cy + 7.0 + 7.4 + PLOT_H
    for i in range(5):
        rule(base - PLOT_H * i / 4, color=GRID, width=0.15)
    if movers:
        slot = CW / len(movers)
        bw = min(15.0, slot * 0.58)
        biggest = size_of_change(movers[0]) or 1.0
        for i, a in enumerate(movers):
            d = float(a.get("difference") or 0)
            col = TEAL if d > 0 else BAR_RED
            cx = L + slot * (i + 0.5)
            bh = max(0.5, PLOT_H * abs(d) / biggest)
            pdf.set_fill_color(*col)
            pdf.rect(cx - bw / 2, base - bh, bw, bh, style="F")
            amt = schange(d)
            fa = shrink(amt, slot - 0.8, 7.2, "B")
            font(fa, "B", color=col)
            pdf.set_xy(cx - slot / 2, base - bh - 6.6)
            pdf.cell(slot, 3.2, safe(amt), align="C")
            pc = pct(d, a.get("previousBalance"))
            fp = shrink(pc, slot - 0.8, 6.4)
            font(fp, "", color=col)
            pdf.set_xy(cx - slot / 2, base - bh - 3.4)
            pdf.cell(slot, 3.0, safe(pc), align="C")
            for j, ln in enumerate(wrap2(str(a.get("name") or ""), slot - 1.2, 6.0)):
                font(6.0, "", color=INK)
                pdf.set_xy(cx - slot / 2, base + 1.4 + j * 2.8)
                pdf.cell(slot, 2.8, ln, align="C")
    else:
        font(8, "", color=GREY)
        pdf.set_xy(L, base - PLOT_H / 2 - 2)
        pdf.cell(CW, 4, safe("No account changed."), align="C")
    rule(base, color=GREY, width=0.3)
    y_now[0] = base + 6.0 + 7.0

    # -- All accounts --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
    label(L, y_now[0] + 1, "All accounts", size=6.5)
    y_now[0] += 4.5
    c_prev, c_bal, c_chg, c_pct = 32.0, 32.0, 38.0, 26.0
    c_acc = CW - c_prev - c_bal - c_chg - c_pct
    x_prev = L + c_acc
    x_bal = x_prev + c_prev
    x_chg = x_bal + c_bal
    x_pct = x_chg + c_chg

    def table_head():
        hlabel(L, y_now[0], c_acc, "Account")
        hlabel(x_prev, y_now[0], c_prev - 2, "Previous close", "R")
        hlabel(x_bal, y_now[0], c_bal - 2, "Balance today", "R")
        hlabel(x_chg, y_now[0], c_chg - 2, "Change", "R")
        hlabel(x_pct, y_now[0], c_pct - 2, "% change", "R")
        y_now[0] += 4.4
        rule(y_now[0], color=NAVY, width=0.4)
        y_now[0] += 1.4

    def group_head(text):
        pdf.set_fill_color(*PAPER)
        pdf.rect(L, y_now[0], CW, 5.0, style="F")
        font(7, "B", color=NAVY)
        pdf.set_xy(L + 1.5, y_now[0] + 0.7)
        pdf.cell(CW - 3, 3.6, safe(text))
        y_now[0] += 5.0

    table_head()
    groups = (1 if movers else 0) + (1 if quiet else 0)
    spare = BOTTOM - 6.0 - y_now[0] - groups * 5.0 - 9.5
    rh = max(4.8, min(9.0, spare / max(len(ordered), 1)))
    two_line = rh >= 7.4

    def account_row(a, live):
        d = float(a.get("difference") or 0)
        tone = tone_rgb(way(d)) if live else GREY
        y = y_now[0]
        ty = y + (0.9 if two_line else (rh - 3.8) / 2)
        font(8.5, "B" if live else "", color=INK if live else GREY)
        pdf.set_xy(L + 1.5, ty)
        pdf.cell(c_acc - 3, 3.8, fit(str(a.get("name") or ""), c_acc - 4, 8.5, "B" if live else ""))
        font(8.5, "", color=INK if live else GREY)
        pdf.set_xy(x_prev, ty)
        pdf.cell(c_prev - 2, 3.8, safe(smoney(a.get("previousBalance"))), align="R")
        font(8.5, "B" if live else "", color=INK if live else GREY)
        pdf.set_xy(x_bal, ty)
        pdf.cell(c_bal - 2, 3.8, safe(smoney(a.get("balance"))), align="R")
        font(8.5, "B" if live else "", color=tone)
        pdf.set_xy(x_chg, ty)
        pdf.cell(c_chg - 2, 3.8, safe(schange(d) if live else "no change"), align="R")
        font(8.5, "B" if live else "", color=tone)
        pdf.set_xy(x_pct, ty)
        pdf.cell(c_pct - 2, 3.8, safe(pct(d, a.get("previousBalance"))), align="R")
        if two_line:
            font(6.4, "", color=GREY)
            pdf.set_xy(x_prev, y + 4.6)
            pdf.cell(c_prev - 2, 3.0, safe(str(a.get("previousDayText") or "")), align="R")
            pdf.set_xy(x_bal, y + 4.6)
            pdf.cell(c_bal - 2, 3.0, safe(str(a.get("todayText") or "")), align="R")
            if live:
                pdf.set_xy(x_chg, y + 4.6)
                pdf.cell(c_chg - 2, 3.0, safe(money(a.get("moneyIn")) + " in / " +
                                              money(abs(float(a.get("moneyOut") or 0))) + " out"), align="R")
        y_now[0] = y + rh
        rule(y_now[0], color=LINE, width=0.15)

    for title, rows, live in (("Accounts that changed (" + str(len(movers)) + ")", movers, True),
                              ("No change (" + str(len(quiet)) + ")", quiet, False)):
        if not rows:
            continue
        if need(5.0 + rh):
            table_head()
        group_head(title)

# ── Have AI explain, in plain English, what moved the balances ──
import json
import re

# The AI step's input cap is 32,000 characters including the prompt, so the brief is trimmed well inside it.
MAX_INPUT = 24000
SHORT_INPUT = 6000
# Transactions sent per account. A day with more than this is summarised by its largest movements.
MAX_TXNS = 40

WRITE_PROMPT = (
    "You are writing the daily bank balance note for the owner of an Australian small business. "
    "The figures come from their Xero bank accounts: each account's balance at the close of the previous "
    "business day, its balance today, and every transaction in between.\n"
    "Write for someone who is not an accountant. Short sentences, plain English, no jargon and no "
    "accounting lecture. Amounts are Australian dollars and are already formatted - quote them exactly as "
    "they appear, never reformat or recalculate them.\n"
    "You are given only the transactions at or above the size in 'listed_from'; the rest of each account's "
    "day is summarised as 'smaller_count' and 'smaller_total'. Write about the ones you were given, and "
    "refer to the others only as the smaller movements - never guess what they were.\n"
    "For each account that moved, say in two or three sentences what moved it: the handful of transactions "
    "that account for most of the change, who they were with, and whether money came in or went out. Name "
    "the real contacts. Do not list every transaction - the report already has the full table underneath.\n"
    "Then give up to four 'watch' points: anything a careful owner would want a second look at, such as a "
    "large or unusual payment, a duplicate-looking pair, bank fees, or an account that has gone negative. "
    "Leave the list empty when nothing stands out - do not invent concerns to fill it.\n"
    "Never state a fact that is not in the data."
)
WRITE_SHAPE = ('{"headline": str, "accounts": [{"name": str, "explanation": str}], "watch": [str]}')

SHORT_PROMPT = (
    "Write one plain-English sentence for the owner of an Australian small business saying how their bank "
    "balances moved since the previous business day. Use the amounts exactly as given. No jargon."
)
SHORT_SHAPE = '{"headline": str}'


def _brief_txn(t):
    return {
        "account_code": str(t.get("accountCode") or ""),
        "coded_to": str(t.get("accountName") or ""),
        "contact": str(t.get("contact") or ""),
        "detail": str(t.get("detail") or ""),
        "amount": str(t.get("amountDisplay") or ""),
        "direction": "out" if float(t.get("amount") or 0) < 0 else "in",
    }


def _by_size(t):
    return -abs(float(t.get("amount") or 0))


change = params.get("change") or {}
problem = str(params.get("problem") or "")
notes = {"headline": "", "accounts": [], "watch": [], "note": ""}

# The report lists transactions of this size and over, so the explanation is written from the same ones.
# Explaining a movement with a payment the reader cannot find on the page would read as a mistake.
try:
    floor = abs(float(params.get("min_amount") or 0))
except (TypeError, ValueError):
    floor = 0.0
floor_text = "A$" + format(floor, ",.0f")

accounts = change.get("accounts") or []
if accounts and not problem:
    brief = {
        "as_at": str((change.get("summary") or {}).get("subtitle") or ""),
        "total_change": str((change.get("summary") or {}).get("totalDifferenceText") or ""),
        "listed_from": floor_text,
        "accounts": [],
    }
    for a in accounts:
        every = a.get("transactions") or []
        big = [t for t in every if abs(float(t.get("amount") or 0)) >= floor]
        small = [t for t in every if abs(float(t.get("amount") or 0)) < floor]
        txns = sorted(big, key=_by_size)
        brief["accounts"].append({
            "name": str(a.get("name") or ""),
            "previous_balance": str(a.get("previousBalanceText") or ""),
            "previous_day": str(a.get("previousDayText") or ""),
            "balance_today": str(a.get("balanceText") or ""),
            "today": str(a.get("todayText") or ""),
            "change": str(a.get("differenceText") or ""),
            "money_in": str(a.get("moneyInText") or ""),
            "money_out": str(a.get("moneyOutText") or ""),
            "transaction_count": len(every),
            "listed_count": len(big),
            "smaller_count": len(small),
            "smaller_total": "A$" + format(abs(sum(float(t.get("amount") or 0) for t in small)), ",.2f"),
            "transactions": [_brief_txn(t) for t in txns[:MAX_TXNS]],
        })

    # A silent fallback here would put the report out with no note at all, so the first failure is kept and
    # a smaller ask is tried before giving up - and if that fails too, the reason is printed on the report.
    written = {}
    try:
        written = api.ai.extract(prompt=WRITE_PROMPT, input=json.dumps(brief)[:MAX_INPUT],
                                 schema_hint=WRITE_SHAPE)
    except Exception as exc:
        reason = str(exc).replace("tool_error: ", "")[:120]
        bare = {"as_at": brief["as_at"], "total_change": brief["total_change"],
                "accounts": [{k: v for k, v in a.items() if k != "transactions"} for a in brief["accounts"]]}
        try:
            written = api.ai.extract(prompt=SHORT_PROMPT, input=json.dumps(bare)[:SHORT_INPUT],
                                     schema_hint=SHORT_SHAPE)
        except Exception:
            written = {}
            notes["note"] = ("AI couldn't write the explanation (" + reason +
                             "). The figures below are straight from Xero and are unaffected.")

    written = written if isinstance(written, dict) else {}
    notes["headline"] = re.sub(r"\s+", " ", str(written.get("headline") or "")).strip()
    known = {str(a.get("name") or "") for a in accounts}
    for row in written.get("accounts") or []:
        if not isinstance(row, dict):
            continue
        name = str(row.get("name") or "")
        text = re.sub(r"\s+", " ", str(row.get("explanation") or "")).strip()
        # Only keep an explanation that names an account Xero actually returned.
        if name in known and text:
            notes["accounts"].append({"name": name, "explanation": text})
    notes["watch"] = [re.sub(r"\s+", " ", str(w)).strip()[:200]
                      for w in (written.get("watch") or []) if str(w).strip()][:4]

summary = problem or notes["note"] or (
    notes["headline"] or "Wrote the explanation for " + str(len(notes["accounts"])) + " account(s).")

# ── Draw the bank transaction detail report, put it in Reports, file the PDF and email it ──
import base64
import io
import re
from datetime import date
from typing import Any

from fpdf import FPDF
from PIL import Image

MAIL = "m365-mail-send"
FOLDER = "Banking/Reports"
MONTHS = ["Jan", "Feb", "Mar", "Apr", "May", "Jun", "Jul", "Aug", "Sep", "Oct", "Nov", "Dec"]
# The masthead logo. Taller than this and it crowds the rule beneath; wider and it reaches the title block.
LOGO_H = 11.0
LOGO_W = 60.0
# The whole PDF is base64'd into the mail connector's request, and a logo straight out of a design tool can
# be megabytes. It is drawn 11mm tall, so a few hundred pixels is every pixel it can show.
LOGO_PX = (960, 240)
LOGO_BYTES = 120_000
# Transactions printed per account. Beyond this the table would run for pages; the rest are counted instead.
MAX_ROWS = 60

NAVY = (22, 37, 64)
GOLD = (176, 141, 87)
GREEN = (29, 115, 80)
RED = (176, 44, 44)
INK = (33, 37, 41)
GREY = (110, 114, 120)
LINE = (222, 220, 214)
PAPER = (244, 242, 237)
WHITE = (255, 255, 255)

FOOTNOTE = "Amounts are rounded to whole dollars, so rounded totals can differ from the sum of rounded lines by A$1."


def safe(s):
    """Core PDF fonts are Latin-1 only."""
    s = str(s or "")
    for a, b in (("–", "-"), ("—", "-"), ("‘", "'"), ("’", "'"), ("“", '"'), ("”", '"'), ("•", "-"),
                 ("…", "..."), ("→", "->"), ("▲", "+"), ("▼", "-"), ("≈", "~"), (" ", " ")):
        s = s.replace(a, b)
    return s.encode("latin-1", "ignore").decode("latin-1")


def esc(s):
    return (str(s or "").replace("&", "&").replace("<", "<").replace(">", ">")
            .replace('"', """))


def d_fmt(iso):
    """dd-Mmm-yy, for the file name, the email subject and the Date column."""
    if not iso:
        return ""
    y, m, d = iso[:10].split("-")
    return d + "-" + MONTHS[int(m) - 1] + "-" + y[2:]


def rnd(n):
    """Whole dollars, half up. Counted in cents first so a sum that lands a hair under .50 still rounds up."""
    cents = int(abs(float(n or 0)) * 100 + 0.5)
    return (cents + 50) // 100


def money(n):
    """A$1,234 - the size of a figure, with no sign."""
    return "A$" + format(rnd(n), ",")


def smoney(n):
    """A balance or an amount with its sign, no plus: -A$1,234. One that rounds to nothing is A$0, never -A$0."""
    r = rnd(n)
    return ("-" if float(n or 0) < 0 and r else "") + "A$" + format(r, ",")


def schange(n):
    """A change with its sign: +A$1,234 or -A$1,234."""
    v = float(n or 0)
    r = rnd(v)
    if not r:
        return "A$0"
    return ("+" if v > 0 else "-") + "A$" + format(r, ",")


def pct(diff, prev, dash="-"):
    """(today - previous close) / ABS(previous close), to 1 decimal place, half up. The sign is the direction of
    the change, so a credit card getting further overdrawn is negative. A previous close of exactly 0 has
    nothing to divide by, and says so with a dash rather than a made-up figure."""
    p = float(prev or 0)
    if p == 0:
        return dash
    v = float(diff or 0) / abs(p) * 100
    tenths = int(abs(v) * 10 + 0.5 + 1e-9)
    if not tenths:
        return "0.0%"
    return ("+" if v > 0 else "-") + format(tenths / 10, ",.1f") + "%"


def nocents(text):
    """Cents out of wording the AI wrote: A$1,234.56 becomes A$1,235, so no figure on the page carries them."""
    return re.sub(r"(-?A?\$-?)(\d[\d,]*)\.(\d{2})\b",
                  lambda m: m.group(1) + format(rnd(float(m.group(2).replace(",", "") + "." + m.group(3))), ","),
                  str(text or ""))


def txn_date(t):
    """dd-Mmm-yy for a transaction, from its date, or failing that from the date the connector wrote beside it."""
    iso = str(t.get("date") or "")
    if re.match(r"\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}", iso):
        return d_fmt(iso)
    m = re.search(r"\d{2}-[A-Z][a-z]{2}-\d{2}", str(t.get("dateText") or "") + " " + str(t.get("detail") or ""))
    return m.group(0) if m else ""


def txn_detail(t):
    """The line under the contact, without the date it used to end on - the Date column has it now."""
    return re.sub(r"\s*·\s*(?:[A-Z][a-z]{2} )?\d{2}-[A-Z][a-z]{2}-\d{2}\s*$", "", str(t.get("detail") or ""))


def tone_rgb(direction):
    return GREEN if direction == "up" else (RED if direction == "down" else GREY)


def tone_css(direction):
    return "#1d7350" if direction == "up" else ("#b02c2c" if direction == "down" else "#6e7278")


def way(n):
    v = float(n or 0)
    return "up" if v > 0 else ("down" if v < 0 else "flat")

def size_of_change(account):

    receipt deserves the same look as a $60,000 payment."""
    return abs(float(txn.get("amount") or 0)) >= floor

            pdf.set_xy(L + CW - 22, y_now[0] + 0.8)
            pdf.cell(22, 3.8, safe(pct(0, a.get("previousBalance"))), align="R")
            y_now[0] += 5.6
            rule(y_now[0], color=LINE, width=0.12)
        y_now[0] += 5

    # -- Grand total -----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
    need(18)
    rule(y_now[0], color=NAVY, width=0.5)
    y_now[0] += 2.2
    font(9.5, "B", color=INK)
    pdf.set_xy(L, y_now[0])
    pdf.cell(CW * 0.5, 4.4, safe("Total across " + str(n_accounts) + acc_word))
    font(9.5, "B", color=tone_rgb(total_dir))
    pdf.set_xy(L, y_now[0])
    pdf.cell(CW - 26, 4.4, safe(schange(total_diff)), align="R")
    pdf.set_xy(L, y_now[0])
    pdf.cell(CW, 4.4, safe(pct(total_diff, opening)), align="R")
    y_now[0] += 5.2
    font(8, "", color=GREY)
    pdf.set_xy(L, y_now[0])
    pdf.cell(CW * 0.7, 3.8, safe("Previous close " + smoney(opening) + "   ->   Balance today " + smoney(closing)))
    pdf.set_xy(L, y_now[0])
    pdf.cell(CW, 3.8, safe(flow_text), align="R")
    y_now[0] += 8

    # -- Worth a look --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
    watch = [nocents(str(w)) for w in (notes.get("watch") or [])]
    if watch:
        need(12 + 6 * len(watch))
        label(L, y_now[0], "Worth a look", color=GOLD)
        y_now[0] += 4
        for w in watch:
            y_now[0] = write(L + 4, y_now[0], CW - 4, "- " + w, size=8.0, lh=4.0) + 1.4
        y_now[0] += 2

    if notes.get("note"):
        need(10)
        y_now[0] = write(L, y_now[0], CW, nocents(str(notes.get("note"))), size=7.2, color=GREY) + 2

    need(6)
    font(6.5, "", color=GREY)
    pdf.set_xy(L, y_now[0] + 1)
    pdf.cell(CW, 3.5, safe(FOOTNOTE))

    # -- The same report as a web page for Reports -----------------------------------------------------------
    h = ["<!doctype html><html><head><meta charset='utf-8'><title>", esc(title_name),
         " - Bank Transaction Detail</title><style>",
         "body{margin:0;padding:28px;background:#fff;color:#212529;",
         "font-family:-apple-system,Segoe UI,Helvetica,Arial,sans-serif;font-size:14px;line-height:1.5}",
         ".wrap{max-width:860px;margin:0 auto}",
         ".mast{display:flex;align-items:flex-end;justify-content:space-between;gap:16px;",
         "border-bottom:3px solid #162540;padding-bottom:10px}",
         ".mast h1{margin:0;font-size:20px;color:#162540;letter-spacing:.02em}",
         ".mast .sub{color:#6e7278;font-size:12px}",
         ".kpis{display:flex;background:#f4f2ed;border:1px solid #dedcd6;border-radius:8px;margin:20px 0}",
         ".kpi{flex:1;padding:14px 18px;border-left:1px solid #dedcd6}.kpi:first-child{border-left:none;flex:1.4}",
         ".lbl{font-size:10px;letter-spacing:.08em;color:#6e7278;text-transform:uppercase;font-weight:700}",
         ".big{font-size:26px;font-weight:700;margin-top:2px;line-height:1.2}",
         ".big .pct{font-size:15px;margin-left:8px}",
         ".kpi .sub{color:#6e7278;font-size:12px}",
         "h2{font-size:16px;color:#162540;margin:26px 0 2px;display:flex;justify-content:space-between}",
         "h2 .pct{margin-left:12px}",
         ".bal{color:#6e7278;font-size:13px;margin:0 0 8px;display:flex;justify-content:space-between}",
         "table{width:100%;border-collapse:collapse;margin-top:8px;table-layout:fixed}",
         "th{font-size:10px;letter-spacing:.08em;text-transform:uppercase;color:#6e7278;text-align:left;",
         "border-bottom:2px solid #162540;padding:6px 6px 6px 0}",
         "th.r,td.r{text-align:right}",
         "td{padding:7px 6px 7px 0;border-bottom:1px solid #f1efe9;vertical-align:top}",
         "td .sub{display:block;color:#6e7278;font-size:11px}",
         "tr.tot td{font-weight:700;border-top:1px solid #162540;border-bottom:none}",
         "tr{break-inside:avoid}thead{display:table-header-group}",
         ".check{color:#1d7350;font-size:12px;margin-top:6px}",
         ".watch{border-top:1px solid #dedcd6;margin-top:26px;padding-top:14px}",
         ".watch h3{font-size:11px;letter-spacing:.08em;text-transform:uppercase;color:#b08d57;margin:0 0 8px}",
         ".foot{border-top:1px solid #dedcd6;margin-top:26px;padding-top:10px;color:#6e7278;font-size:11px}",
         "</style></head><body><div class='wrap'><div class='mast'><div>"]
    h.append("<img src='" + logo_uri + "' alt='' style='max-height:40px'>" if logo_uri
             else "<h1>" + esc(title_name) + "</h1>")
    h.append("</div><div style='text-align:right'><h1>BANK TRANSACTION DETAIL</h1><div class='sub'>" +
             esc(subline) + "</div></div></div>")
    h.append("<div class='kpis'><div class='kpi'><div class='lbl'>Total change across " + str(n_accounts) +
             acc_word + "</div><div class='big' style='color:" + tone_css(total_dir) + "'>" +
             esc(schange(total_diff)) + "<span class='pct'>" + esc(pct(total_diff, opening, "—")) +
             "</span></div><div class='sub'>vs previous close " + esc(smoney(opening)) + "</div></div>" +
             "<div class='kpi'><div class='lbl'>Listed in this report</div><div class='big' "
             "style='color:#162540'>" + str(big_count) + "</div><div class='sub'>of " + str(all_count) +
             " transactions, " + esc(floor_text) + " and over</div></div>" +
             "<div class='kpi'><div class='lbl'>Money in / out</div><div class='big' style='font-size:16px;"
             "margin-top:9px;white-space:nowrap'><span style='color:#1d7350'>" + esc(money(flow_in)) + " in</span> <span "
             "style='color:#6e7278'>/</span> <span style='color:#b02c2c'>" + esc(money(flow_out)) +
             " out</span></div><div class='sub'>across " + str(len(movers)) +
             (" account" if len(movers) == 1 else " accounts") + " that moved</div></div></div>")
    if headline:
        h.append("<p>" + esc(headline) + "</p>")
    for a in movers:
        name = str(a.get("name") or "")
        direction = way(a.get("difference"))
        big_txns = shown.get(name) or []
        small = rest.get(name) or []
        small_total = sum(float(t.get("amount") or 0) for t in small)
        all_total = small_total + sum(float(t.get("amount") or 0) for t in big_txns)
        a_in = money(a.get("moneyIn")) + " in / " + money(abs(float(a.get("moneyOut") or 0))) + " out"
        h.append("<h2><span>" + esc(name) + "</span><span style='color:" + tone_css(direction) + "'>" +
                 esc(schange(a.get("difference"))) + "<span class='pct'>" +
                 esc(pct(a.get("difference"), a.get("previousBalance"), "—")) + "</span></span></h2>")
        h.append("<p class='bal'><span>Previous close " + esc(str(a.get("previousDayText") or "")) + " " +
                 esc(smoney(a.get("previousBalance"))) + " → Balance today " +
                 esc(str(a.get("todayText") or "")) + " " + esc(smoney(a.get("balance"))) + "</span><span>" +
                 esc(a_in) + "</span></p>")
        if by_name.get(name):
            h.append("<p>" + esc(by_name[name]) + "</p>")
        if not big_txns:
            h.append("<p class='bal'>No transactions of " + esc(floor_text) + " and over; " + str(len(small)) +
                     " smaller transaction" + ("" if len(small) == 1 else "s") + " (" +
                     esc(smoney(small_total)) + (" net out" if small_total < 0 else " net in") + ").</p>")
            continue
        h.append("<table><colgroup><col style='width:22%'><col style='width:15%'><col style='width:11%'>"
                 "<col style='width:37%'><col style='width:15%'></colgroup><thead><tr><th>Xero Account</th>"
                 "<th>Acc Code</th><th>Date</th><th>Contact</th>"
                 "<th class='r'>Amount</th></tr></thead><tbody>")
        for t in big_txns[:MAX_ROWS]:
            out = float(t.get("amount") or 0) < 0
            h.append("<tr><td>" + esc(str(t.get("bankAccount") or name)) + "</td><td><strong>" +
                     esc(str(t.get("accountCode") or "")) + "</strong><span class='sub'>" +
                     esc(str(t.get("accountName") or "")) + "</span></td><td>" + esc(txn_date(t)) +
                     "</td><td><strong>" + esc(str(t.get("contact") or "")) + "</strong><span class='sub'>" +
                     esc(txn_detail(t)) + "</span></td><td class='r' style='font-weight:700;color:" +
                     ("#b02c2c" if out else "#212529") + "'>" + esc(smoney(t.get("amount"))) + "</td></tr>")
        extra = len(big_txns) - MAX_ROWS
        if extra > 0:
            h.append("<tr><td colspan='5' class='sub' style='color:#6e7278'>and " + str(extra) +
                     " more, in Xero.</td></tr>")
        if small:
            h.append("<tr><td colspan='4' style='color:#6e7278'>" + str(len(small)) + " transaction" +
                     ("" if len(small) == 1 else "s") + " under " + esc(floor_text) +
                     "</td><td class='r' style='color:#6e7278'>" + esc(smoney(small_total)) + "</td></tr>")
        h.append("<tr class='tot'><td>Total</td><td></td><td></td><td class='r' style='font-weight:400;"
                 "color:#6e7278'>" + esc(a_in) + "</td><td class='r'>" + esc(smoney(all_total)) +
                 "</td></tr></tbody></table>")
        h.append("<div class='check'>" + esc(nocents(str(a.get("checkText") or ""))) + "</div>")
    if quiet:
        h.append("<h2><span>No change (" + str(len(quiet)) + ")</span></h2>")
        h.append("<table><thead><tr><th>Xero Account</th><th class='r'>Balance today</th>"
                 "<th class='r'>Change</th><th class='r'>% change</th></tr></thead><tbody>")
        for a in quiet:
            h.append("<tr style='color:#6e7278'><td>" + esc(str(a.get("name") or "")) + "</td><td class='r'>" +
                     esc(smoney(a.get("balance"))) + "</td><td class='r'>no change</td><td class='r'>" +
                     esc(pct(0, a.get("previousBalance"), "—")) + "</td></tr>")
        h.append("</tbody></table>")
    h.append("<h2 style='border-top:2px solid #162540;padding-top:10px'><span>Total across " + str(n_accounts) +
             acc_word + "</span><span style='color:" + tone_css(total_dir) + "'>" + esc(schange(total_diff)) +
             "<span class='pct'>" + esc(pct(total_diff, opening, "—")) + "</span></span></h2>")
    h.append("<p class='bal'><span>Previous close " + esc(smoney(opening)) + " → Balance today " +
             esc(smoney(closing)) + "</span><span>" + esc(flow_text) + "</span></p>")
    if watch:
        h.append("<div class='watch'><h3>Worth a look</h3><ul>")
        for w in watch:
            h.append("<li>" + esc(w) + "</li>")
        h.append("</ul></div>")
    if notes.get("note"):
        h.append("<p class='foot'>" + esc(nocents(str(notes.get("note")))) + "</p>")
    h.append("<div class='foot'>" + esc(FOOTNOTE) + "<br>" + esc(updated) + "</div></div></body></html>")
    page_html = "".join(h)

    # -- Save and send ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
    data = bytes(pdf.output())
    clean = re.sub(r"\s+", " ", re.sub(r"[^A-Za-z0-9 ._-]+", " ", title_name)).strip() or "Bank"
    title = clean + " Bank Transaction Detail " + d_fmt(today)
    report_file = FOLDER + "/" + title + ".pdf"
    path = api.files.scratch_path("transaction-detail.pdf")
    with open(path, "wb") as fh:
        fh.write(data)
    api.files.put(file=report_file, scratch_file=path)

    # Reports shows HTML, not PDFs, so the page goes up as HTML there and the PDF stays the copy that is
    # filed in Knowledge and emailed.
    html_path = api.files.scratch_path("transaction-detail.html")
    with open(html_path, "w", encoding="utf-8") as fh:
        fh.write(page_html)
    try:
        # The bridge would derive "text/html; charset=utf-8" from the .html name, and the artifact manager
        # rejects a mime carrying a ";" (it is echoed into a Content-Type header), so name it plainly here.
        made = api.artifacts.put(title=title, scratch_file=html_path, file_name=title + ".html",
                                 kind="document", visibility="tenant", mime_type="text/html",
                                 description="Bank transactions of " + floor_text + " and over since the "
                                 "previous business day, across " + str(len(accounts)) +
                                 " Xero bank account(s).",
                                 tags=["bank transactions", "xero"])
        report_link = str((made or {}).get("url") or "") if isinstance(made, dict) else ""
    except Exception as exc:
        filed = ", but couldn't put it in Reports (" + str(exc).replace("tool_error: ", "")[:200] + ")"
    else:
        filed = " to Reports"

    if to:
        # Short and plain on purpose: the PDF has the full listing, so the email only says what is attached
        # and anything worth a look, in the words a person would use.
        many = big_count != 1
        lines = ["Hi,", "",
                 "Here's the bank transaction detail" + (" for " + org_name if org_name else "") + " for " +
                 d_fmt(today) + ". The PDF is attached and lists every transaction of " + floor_text +
                 " and over - " + ("there were " if many else "there was ") + str(big_count) + " today."]
        if watch:
            lines += ["", "A few things worth a look:" if len(watch) > 1 else "One thing worth a look:"]
            lines += ["- " + w for w in watch]
        lines += ["", "Thanks"]
        try:
            api.connectors.invoke(server=MAIL, tool="send_email", args={
                "to": to,
                "subject": "Bank Balance Detailed Summary Report - " + d_fmt(today),
                "body": "\n".join(lines),
                "attachments": [{"name": title + ".pdf", "contentBase64": base64.b64encode(data).decode(),
                                 "contentType": "application/pdf"}],
            })
            emailed_to = ", ".join(to)
            sent = " and emailed it to " + emailed_to
        except Exception as exc:
            sent = ", but couldn't email it (" + str(exc).replace("tool_error: ", "")[:200] + ")"
    else:
        sent = " (nobody was picked to receive it, so it wasn't emailed)"

    summary = "Saved " + report_file + filed + sent + "." + logo_note + lost_note

nodes.summary: Draws the transactions at or above the amount set, account by account, as both a web page and a PDF, puts the web page in Reports, files the PDF in Knowledge as Banking/Reports/<name> Bank Transaction Detail <date>.pdf, and emails it to the people picked.
nodes.title: Write the transaction detail and email it

params.description: Which Xero organisation to report on. Part of the name is enough - "irvine" finds Irvine Jackson Pty Ltd. Leave it blank to use whichever organisation the connection defaults to. An automation does not follow the organisation picker on your dashboard, so if the report names a different organisation than the Bank Balance Change tile, put the tile's organisation here. If what you type matches no connected organisation, or more than one, the run stops and names the ones it found rather than reporting on the wrong books.
params.label: Xero organisation
params.name: xero_org

params.description: Only transactions this size or bigger get a line of their own. Size is what counts, not direction: at A$50,000 a payment of A$60,000 and a receipt of A$60,000 both appear. Everything smaller is counted on one line per account, so the totals still add up. Set it to 0 to list every transaction.
params.label: Smallest transaction to list
params.name: min_amount

params.description: Who in the workspace gets the report.
params.label: Send to person
params.name: email_user

params.description: Any other addresses, for people outside the workspace. Separate several with commas. Leave all three blank and the report is still saved to Reports and Knowledge, but nothing is emailed.
params.label: Other email addresses

params.description: Optional. A logo in Knowledge to put at the top of the report, for example Automations/logo.png.
